title.zh: 光的反射与折射 · 拐弯的规矩

desc.zh: 光撞上界面会拐弯，拐多少有规矩：反射角等于入射角、而且都从法线量起；进了水会偏向法线；从水里往外射、角度太陡还会全部反射回去；连鱼在水里的位置都是假的——眼睛看到的虚像比真身浅。
desc.en: Light bends at a boundary, and the bending follows rules: the angle of reflection equals the angle of incidence, and both are measured from the normal; entering water it bends toward the normal; leaving water too steeply, it reflects entirely back. Even a fish is not where it looks — the virtual image your eye sees sits shallower than the fish itself.
